$comment: Sprint 09 owned: the historical V1 worker handoff payload of the SUPPORTED v1.0 compatibility variant. Unlike the V2 worker-result schema (which forbids them), this schema ALLOWS the known V1 worker-reportable fields (docs/worker-contract.md section 2) — including workerStatus PATCH_READY, the legacy evidence field (string or array), and objective-evidence fields (changedFiles, lineCount, patchHash, baseSha, headSha, testLogPath, testExitStatus, secretScan, integrationStatus). In V1 these are WORKER CLAIMS, never controller facts; the projection never promotes them. A payload that fails this schema is parseable-but-historically-schema-invalid: it is NEVER declared V2-valid and NEVER treated as 'no patch' or 'failed implementation'. additionalProperties=false keeps the variant vocabulary deterministic: unknown fields make the instance schema-invalid instead of being silently accepted. Public-safe: bounded fields only; raw response text never leaves the read-only parser.
title: LCIM V1 compatibility worker handoff
